species.name: Mystical
species.description: Common in many parts of the world, these bees have a little extra whimsy about them.|Apinomicon

species.name: Sorcerous
species.description: Fond of warm, dry environments, they seem to have the ability to conjure water from thin air.|Apinomicon

species.name: Unusual
species.description: "A curious specimen for my collection!"|Junior Apiarist

species.name: Attuned
species.description: They fly as though guided by unseen threads through the air.|Apinomicon

species.name: Eldritch
species.description: The potential that was locked within this bee's ancestors has now come to the fore.|Apinomicon

species.name: Esoteric
species.description: An unusual crossbreed which seems to have magical properties.|Apinomicon

species.name: Mysterious
species.description: These bees have been to the end of the world and back, and their power has grown.|Apinomicon

species.name: Arcane
species.description: "Their produce is charged with magic."|Azanor, Master Thaumaturge

species.name: Charmed
species.description: Your first experiments in Thaumaturgical Apiculture have yielded fruit. Buzzing fruit.|Apinomicon

species.name: Enchanted
species.description: Successive generations of Charmed bees have reinforced their connection to the unknown.|Apinomicon

species.name: Supernatural
species.description: These bees walk the line between this world and the unseen.|Apinomicon

species.name: Ethereal
species.description: Ghostly, and charged with energy from beyond.|Apinomicon

species.name: Watery
species.description: Fond of damp spots and flowing water.|Apinomicon

species.name: Earthen
species.description: They have an iron-strong connection with stone and dirt.|Apinomicon

species.name: Firey
species.description: As close as you can get to living flame without involving candescence.|Apinomicon

species.name: Windy
species.description: Rarely seen in flat, wide open spaces. Their territories are vast.|Apinomicon

species.name: Pupil
species.description: "What does that bee want with my paper?!"|Yorae, Librarian

species.name: Scholarly
species.description: "I can't be sure, but I think they might be smarter than me..."|Yorae, Librarian

species.name: Savant
species.description: lim(x^(i / pi)/ log(e * 7 - ln(32/x^-pi))). Solve for honey.|Note found on Yorae's desk

species.name: Aware
species.description: "They can see into your soul!"|Florastar, Expert Beekeeper

species.name: Spirit
species.description: It is said these bees are able to contact the dead.|Apinomicon

species.name: Soul
species.description: "The Dread Pirate Roberts has come for your SOOOOOOULS!"|Dread Pirate Roberts

species.name: Skulking
species.description: These bees have become xenophobic and bad-tempered. Use caution.|Apinomicon

species.name: Spidery
species.description: Spiderbee; n. Does whatever a spider-bee does.|Unknown

species.name: Smouldering
species.description: The Skulking bees have become alight with the fire of the ever-burning Blazes.|Apinomicon

species.name: Brainy
species.description: Their combs may be fetid and foul-smelling, but their intelligence is well-developed.|Apinomicon

species.name: Big Bad
species.description: "Who is afraid of the Big Bad Chris?"|Pahimar, last words

species.name: Poultry
species.description: "Cluck. Cluck cluck! ... You heard me."|Confused bee

species.name: Batty
species.description: They tend to attract bats to their hives through means unknown.|Apinomicon

species.name: Timely
species.description: "An apiarist is never late. He arrives precisely when he means to!"|Sengir, Mad Apiarist

species.name: Lordly
species.description: They live in peace, within the sight of the Eye of Harmony|Tattered Remains of ancient Apinomicon

species.name: Doctoral
species.description: "Would you like a Jelly Baby?"|Passing stranger with a great scarf and a blue box

species.name: Infernal
species.description: Spawned deep within the hellish realm, none have survived long enough to determine their abilities.|Apinomicon

species.name: Hateful
species.description: Continued exposure to the Nether has not improved their temperament in the least. Use caution.|Apinomicon

species.name: Spiteful
species.description: They guard their territory fiercely, with the zeal of fiends, and welts of fire.|Apinomicon

species.name: Withering
species.description: Their mere passing causes life to fail, slowly drawing all energy from their territory.|Apinomicon

species.name: Oblivion
species.description: It is unclear whether these bees are native to this world, or some other.|Apinomicon

species.name: Nameless
species.description: "Other naturalists have refused to study these bees. I must know why."|Tattered Research Notes

species.name: Abandoned
species.description: "The more I study these bees, the more I feel they do not belong here, or anywhere else."|Tattered Research Notes

species.name: Forlorn
species.description: "I am now convinced they were left in our universe on purpose by some unknowable beings."|Tattered Research Notes

species.name: Draconic
species.description: "With a fel sound, they erupted from their hive. That was the last we ever saw of Gerald."|Tattered Research Notes

species.name: Ferrous
species.description: Having absorbed some of the base metal, these bees can concentrate the essence of iron from the region.|Apinomicon

species.name: Auric
species.description: Not all that glitters is gold.|Ancient Aphorism

species.name: Cuprum
species.description: A base metal common in many applications; these bees are helpful for resource-starved magicians.|Apinomicon

species.name: Stannum
species.description: While metalic, these bees are suprisingly fragile.|Apinomicon

species.name: Argentum
species.description: While they do not recieve as much attention as Golden bees, they are nonetheless valuable.|Apinomicon

species.name: Plumbum
species.description: A favourite of amateur alchemists, they believe they can transform these bees into gold.|Apinomicon

species.name: Ardite
species.description: Fond of yellowish-orange material found in hellish areas.|Apinomicon

species.name: Cobalt
species.description: The unstable properties of this material seem to not affect the bees in the slightest.|Apinomicon

species.name: Diamandi
species.description: Crystalline, glittering, and harder than dragon's teeth. These bees are none of those.|Apinomicon

species.name: Esmeraldi
species.description: It is said they have been to a land ruled by a Great Wizard, and have taken the aspect of his city.|Apinomicon

species.name: Apatine
species.description: Day and night the whining droned on. I barricaded the windows and hid in the cellar, but everywhere the high-pitched noise of the apatine bees penetrated the walls and drove me to distraction.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Silicon
species.description: "Not to be confused with Silicone bees, AKA the Boo Bees!"|Myrathi, Wearer of Headpants

species.name: Certus
species.description: The OTHER kind of Quartz, slightly bluer, but no less valuable.|Apinomicon

species.name: Fluix
species.description: Fusing properties of Redstone, Nether Quartz and Certus Quartz, the Fluix crystal itself is unusual, unstable, and volatile if struck with TNT.|Apinomicon

species.name: Mutable
species.description: Changeable in nature, mercurial in personality.|Apinomicon

species.name: Transmuting
species.description: "I could've sworn this was made out of stone yesterday!"|Sengir, Mad Apiarist

species.name: Crumbling
species.description: They have a corrosive effect on their surroundings, rapidly aging them.|Apinomicon

species.name: Invisible
species.description: Easy to miss, their glassy body is difficult to spot in the countryside.|Apinomicon

species.name: Aer
species.description: "They work so fast it's breathtaking."|Sengir, Mad Apiarist

species.name: Ignis
species.description: Caution: Contents of hive extremely hot.|Warning label on Azanor's apiary

species.name: Aqua
species.description: "I tried to breed them once, but that was a wash."|MysteriousAges, Apprentice Thaumaturge

species.name: Solum
species.description: "You're really gonna dig these bees, but watch out - they bore quite easily."|MysteriousAges, Apprentice Comedian

species.name: Ordered
species.description: Their combs are nearly perfect, each part mirroring the pattern of the whole.|Apinomicon

species.name: Chaotic
species.description: The social structure of their hives seems to vary day by day, making it more flexible and resillient than others, but significantly more unpredictable.|Apinomicon

species.name: Essentia
species.description: "Why spam Essentia Condensers when you can just use bees?"|Quantumly, Condenser Enjoyer

species.name: Vis
species.description: "They can feel changes in the aura, but are not yet able to affect it."|Azanor, research notes

species.name: Rejuvenating
species.description: The hum of the hive is magical, and over time is absorbed by nearby nodes.|Apinomicon

species.name: Empowering
species.description: So charged with aura are they, that nodes seem to wax in their presence.|Apinomicon

species.name: Nexus
species.description: Spoken only of in hushed whispers, their abilities to pass through nodes into the other side is scoffed at as imagined and fantasy.|Apinomicon

species.name: Flux
species.description: "I thought they would help clean up, but it only makes things worse!"|Kreicus, Apprentice Thaumaturge

species.name: Ravening
species.description: It is unknown how the bees take raw essence from the nodes and what they do with it, but the process eventually transforms the node into a terrifying vortex.|Apinomicon

species.name: Wispy
species.description: Their language is garbled and unintelligible. It is probable they are speaking to unnatural beings.|Apinomicon

species.name: Void
species.description: §kNeque porro quisquam est qui dolorem ipsum quia dolor sit amet, consectetur, adipisci velit|?????

species.name: Electrum
species.description: The best of both precious metals, but somehow greater than both.|Apinomicon

species.name: Nickel
species.description: "If I had a Nickel every time I've heard that... I'd have a hive!"|Marquis Muskrat

species.name: Invar
species.description: "The coefficient of thermal expansion is quite low. Also, it's a pun!"|Marquis Muskrat

species.name: Bronzed
species.description: "I love these bees so much, I had them preserved for later."|Marquis Muskrat

species.name: Rooted
species.description: "If you square these bees, they won't be rooted anymore."|MysteriousAges, bad at math jokes

species.name: Botanic
species.description: Infused with mystical life, they propogate mystical flowers.|Apinomicon

species.name: Blossom
species.description: The mere presence of these bees encourages buds to flower faster.|Apinomicon

species.name: Floral
species.description: They love flowers so much, they pratically bring the blossoms back to the hive.|Apinomicon

species.name: Vazbee
species.description: This isn't a cosplay bee!|Lexica Botania

species.name: Somnolent
species.description: Slow and sluggish, they work slowly compared to most other species.|Apinomicon

species.name: Dreaming
species.description: These bees spend an inordinate time inactive and asleep; there is no way to know what they dream of.|Apinomicon

species.name: Alfheim
species.description: They recall their time in Alfheim, and yearn for a world infused with mana, and seek to make it so.|Apinomicon

species.name: Skystone
species.description: Born of the union of the Earth and the Sky, falling to the ground, wreathed in flame.|Apinomicon

species.name: Forest
species.description: One of the most common pests in forests; Mostly docile.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Meadows
species.description: Infests mostly plains in temperate climates; Mostly docile.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Common
species.description: Considered the beginner apiarist's badge of participation.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Cultivated
species.description: Fast working bee; Thinks anything but opera is beneath it.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Noble
species.description: "There is no more noble occupation in the world than to breed another bee."|Binnie, Apiarist

species.name: Imperial
species.description: Highly sought after bee; Specialises in the production of precious royal jelly.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Diligent
species.description: Mostly noted as a stepping stone for the industrious line of bees.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Industrious
species.description: Highly sought after bee; Specialises in the production of exquisite pollen.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Steadfast
species.description: Considered extinct until some were found by adventurers in a deep dungeon.|Apiarist's Grimoire

species.name: Valiant
species.description: A rare subspecies rarely seen cohabiting in mundane hives.|Apiarist's Grimoire

species.name: Heroic
species.description: Elaborate legends have surrounded this species. Will defend its hive to its death against any hostiles.|Apiarist's Grimoire

species.name: Sinister
species.description: Not many bee species are able to survive in the nether. And even those are severly affected by their hellish environment.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Fiendish
species.description: Experienced nether apiarist's have been reporting severe attacks by their bees. Caution is advised.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Demonic
species.description: Born in the fires of the nether and being a descendant of generations of nether bees has caused this species to turn into a true demon.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Modest
species.description: Hot and arid climates have forced this species to adapt to a degree which will not allow it to survive in significantly friendlier climates.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Frugal
species.description: Generations of bees baked in the sun to produce this species.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Austere
species.description: Dangerous and volatile; Beekeepers are advised to stay in full suit whenever near.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Tropical
species.description: "My travels along the jungle river allowed me to catch many of these poisonous specimen. Unfortunately I had lost my only austere branch to crocodiles a while back."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Exotic
species.description: "The fever shook me and my apiarist's suit was drenched with cold sweat, but with trembling hands I finally managed to pull one of these from my apiary."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Edenic
species.description: "I furiously scribbled in my notebook, drawing sketches of the images I felt seeping into my brain while I was watching the insects perform their strange little dance."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Ender
species.description: "I found one of these seemingly hermitical insects in a villager's apiary. It was torpid, obviously ripped from its world and longing for a fragment from it."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Spectral
species.description: "I was unsure whether it was alive as it lay there in the palm of my hand, glimmering and pulsating, oozing a coldness I never felt before. Then I heard the pile of bones behind me rattle..."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Phantasmal
species.description: "Whatever you do, do not, I repeat, DO NOT drop the dragon e..."|"Sir" Sengir, Last Words

species.name: Wintry
species.description: Common, but winter-hardened bee tribe; Cultivation in warmer climates is a challenge.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Icy
species.description: Temperatures inside hives inhabited by this species will drop until ice shards form.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Vindictive
species.description: "It ate my face! It ate my face!"|K.M.

species.name: Avenging
species.description: "The walls of my house began to crumble and I heard the roof creaking over my head, but I cared not! I felt the stabs of a thousand little insects on my glove as I grabbed the new queen."|Anonymous

species.name: Leporine
species.description: "I swear! It was tiny, had wings and I definitely saw fluffy little rabbit ears! ... No! I am not drunk!"|"Sir" Sengir, madman

species.name: Tipsy
species.description: "Dance my pretties! Dance!"|Tipsy Witch of the East

species.name: Rural
species.description: "Rain in May promises much hay."|M. Ages, Rural Beekeeper

species.name: Farmerly
species.description: Commonly seen in large expanses of prairie, the breadbasket of nations.|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Agrarian
species.description: "Doesn't reek as much as the alternative. Gets the job done, eh?"|Myrathi, Cannie Beekeeper

species.name: Miry
species.description: "How do bees even pollinate fungi?"|Mezz, Junior Apiarist

species.name: Boggy
species.description: "I saw a cow get stung by one of these once. Seconds later, it started sprouting mushrooms all over! ... A photo? Uh, didn't take one."|"Sir" Sengir, madman

species.name: Monastic
species.description: "I remained austere and said to him: 'Not only a princess, but also a whole pile of emeralds for a measly drone? That's extortion!'|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Secluded
species.description: "Crossbreeding with the desert kind was a mistake. My bees withdrew more and more from the outside world."|Beekeeping 101

species.name: Hermitic
species.description: "My dear colleague! I noticed the bees you sent me refuse to wash and are growing full beards. Care to explain?"|Binnie, Apiarist

species.name: Arid
species.description: Fond of dry landscapes, their combs are quite waxy and contain less honey.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Barren
species.description: Preferring deserts, they can live their entire lives without seeing flowers of any kind.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Desolate
species.description: They thrive in blasted wastelands where other life simply withers away.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Decaying
species.description: These bees have an unusual attraction to dead, rotting meat and will store it in their combs. The smell also attracts other unsavoury types.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Skeletal
species.description: Largely unable to defend their hives in the wild, they attract other creatures to guard their homes.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Creepy
species.description: You're sure to get a bang out of these bees.|Binnie, Apiarist

species.name: Rocky
species.description: If only I could find them Rolling Bees, then I might get some good music.|Mysterious Apiarist

species.name: Tolerant
species.description: Part of their hive is made out of stone and use less wax than before.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Robust
species.description: Capable of burrowing through solid rock, they have an extraordinary affinity for minerals hidden in rocks.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Resilient
species.description: Generations of breeding Rocky bees and their offspring has resulted in offspring that have begun to consume minerals as part of their diet.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Corroded
species.description: These are infamous for causing power issues by gnawing on the copper wires in walls.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Tarnished
species.description: Their bodies have a metallic coating, which they shed and incorporate into their combs.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Rusty
species.description: Oh, rusty bees. Do I need a tetanus shot?|Jadedcat, Apiarist

species.name: Leaden
species.description: "It should be easy to turn these into gold!"|Pahimar, Alchemist

species.name: Valuable
species.description: Ohhhhh, look how shiny this bee is.|Jadedcat, Apiarist

species.name: Emerald
species.description: Look at this bee, it's even shinier!|Jadedcat, Apiarist

species.name: Diamond
species.description: Oh my god, this is definitely the shiniest bee!|Jadedcat, Apiarist

species.name: Fermented
species.description: Go home bee, you're drunk.|Jadedcat, Apiarist

species.name: Caffeinated
species.description: The only drawback is that they don't actually brew the coffee for you.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Embittered
species.description: It is unknown how they first arrived in the Nether, but its influence has made them aggresive.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Furious
species.description: An unusual mutation has activated recessive genes that cause high levels of anger in this bee.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Volcanic
species.description: At some point during their evolution, they seem to have acquired traits from Blazes.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Excited
species.description: Redstone acts as a source of extra energy for these bees.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Energetic
species.description: Oh my god. Something happened. House on fire, house on fire.|Generikb, Panicked Apiarist

species.name: Ecstatic
species.description: After accumulating excessive static electricity from Redstone, they produce powerful lightning arcs. Use caution, and maybe a lightning rod.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Maroon
species.description: Don't let them sting you,  or you may be seeing red.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Saffron
species.description: They're dyeing to brighten your day with their honey.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Prussian
species.description: "Cheer up, bee. You're looking a little blue."|Mysterious Apiarist

species.name: Natural
species.description: Perhaps it is an attempt at camoflauge, but these bees have begun producing dyes that match the colour of leaves and grass.|Apiarist Manual

species.name: Jaded
species.description: I bred all the bees and all I got is some bloody purple dye!|Jaded, Sengir's Chosen

species.name: Chad
species.description: GTNH Bienen: Das Beste Was Es Gibt.

species.name: Derpious
species.description: A curious specimen, seems to be mostly interested in spreading flowers and derping around.

species.name: Scummy
species.description: Kerosene, propylene glycol, artificial sweeteners, sulfuric acid, rum, acetone, red dye #2, scumm, axle grease, battery acid and/or pepperoni|Strange people in a bar

species.name: Machinist
species.description: The Machinist Queen, born from the synergy of active machinery and roaring fire. It manufactures essential components needed to build and expand an apiarists empire.||Aditya & Noila
